o.text: From Proto-Common Turkic *körpe. Cognates with Turkish körpe, Uyghur كۆرپە (körpe), etc.
From Arabic قوم (qawm, “tribe, family”). Doublet of qövm.
Equivalent to islanmaq (“to become wet”) + -k. Compare Chuvash исленчӗк (islenč̬ĕk).
